about: The OpenRig version and commit that shared/src/openrig mirrors. `npm run provenance` diffs the mirror against this commit; a clean run with --update-pin moves it.

source.note: Read-only reference clone. Override with OPENRIG_SRC. Files are read with `git show <commit>:<path>`, never checked out.

cli.note: Installed @openrig/cli, used only to load its ./spec-validation export. Override with OPENRIG_CLI.
